# AgentPress Material Kit: LiteLLM: reliability testing spend

Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/guides/reliability_testing_spend
Ecosystem: LiteLLM
Painpoint: agents frequently need compact, citation-ready context for proxy/provider/error routing docs: reliability testing spend

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py provider-error-explainer --error "common implementation failure" --json
```

Machine files:
- material-manifest.json
- proof-receipt.json
- RUN_THIS.md

Rules:
- No external comments/DMs without explicit human approval.
- No claims of maintainer adoption.
- Keep examples small, sanitized, and reproducible.
